content: Řumur n ujeǧid Dariyus
Xenni issuffeɣ ujeǧid Dariyus řumur uca arzun di taddart n idlisen ittwannḍen, mani ttwaxemmřent txubay din di Babil.
Xenni ittwaf di Aḥmata ijj n wedlis ittwannḍen di lqelɛa tenni iǧan di lɛamala n Midya u dayes tuɣa tira-ya n řidaret:

“Deg useggʷas amezwaru n ujeǧid Kurac, issuffeɣ Kurac řumur-a: ‘X Taddart n Arebbi di Urcalim. Aqa ittxeṣṣa ad tᵉttwabna Taddart nni twařa nneɣnit deg wemcan mani qeddmen tiɣarṣa u ittxeṣṣa ad ttwaɛeddřen dsusa nnes. Řuɛřa nnes ad tiři settin n iɣaǧen, tiru nnes settin n iɣaǧen,
s třata n řesdud n tṣuḍar timeqqranin d ijj n ssedd n tefřawt d jdid. Min din ixeṣṣen ad zzayes tᵉttwakellef zi taddart n ujeǧid.

Uřa d řeqcuɛ n wureɣ d nnuqart n Taddart n Arebbi, tinni ikkes Nabuxadnaṣṣar zi Zzawect Tameqqrant nni iǧan di Urcalim u iwyi tent ɣar Babil, ad ttwarrent. man aya marra ad dd-idweř ɣar Zzawect Tameqqrant di Urcalim, ɣar wemcan nnes. Ittxeṣṣa ad temmarsed marra man aya di Taddart n Arebbi.’
S uya, Tatnay, lwali n temmurt x ujemmaḍ n iɣzar n Lfuraṭ, Catar-Buznay d iqqrinen nnes di řxedmet, iqqrinen nni iǧan x ujemmaḍ n iɣzar n Lfuraṭ, aggʷejem ssenni!
Jjem řxedmet di ṭṭweɛ n Taddart-a n Arebbi, ḥima lwali n Wudayen ak-d imɣaren n Wudayen ad bnan Taddart-a n Arebbi twařa nneɣnit deg wemcan nnes.

Ɛawed ittwassuffeɣ-dd zzayi řumur x min ittxeṣṣa ad teggem i imɣaren n Wudayen-a maḥend ad tᵉttwabna Taddart-a n Arebbi twařat nneɣni. Zeg wagřa n ujeǧid, zi ljizya n temmurt x ujemmaḍ n iɣzar n Lfuraṭ, ad ittwaxeǧeṣ s cḍaret min ittxeṣṣen iryazen-a maḥend war tᵉttbeddi ca řxedmet.

U min ittxeṣṣen zeg ifunasen imeẓyanen d icarriyyen d izmaren d tɣarṣi n wecmaḍ i Arebbi n ijenwan, u min ittxeṣṣen zeg irden d tmeǧaḥt d binu d zzect ɛlaḥsab awař n ikehhanen i iǧan di Urcalim, ad asen immewc zeg wass ɣar wass, ḥima war ittxeṣṣi uřa d walu,
ḥima ad qeddmen ict n řefwaḥet ittfuḥen i Arebbi n ijenwan uca ad ẓẓaǧen di ṭṭweɛ n tudart n ujeǧid d iḥenjiren nnes.

ittwassuffeɣ-dd zzayi řumur ḥima kuř ijjen wenni i ɣa ibeddřen tawṣeyyet-a, ad ittwakkes ijj n weɛmud zi taddart nnes ad t ssbedden, ad xas ittwayeř netta uca di ssibbet-a ad tedweř taddart nnes d ict n tzubact n řeɣbar.

Ejj ad ihdem Arebbi, wenni din issezdɣen Isem nnes, kuř ajeǧid d kuř řgens nni i ɣa isswiẓẓḍen afus nnes maḥend ad ibeddeř niɣ ad yareddeǧ Taddart n Arebbi nni iǧan di Urcalim. Necc Dariyus, d wenni iwcin řumur. Ejj ad ittwagg man aya s cḍaret.”
Adeccen n Zzawect Tameqqrant d Řɛid amezwaru n Tɣarṣt n Useɛdu
Xenni Tatnay, lwali n temmurt x ujemmaḍ n iɣzar n Lfuraṭ, ak-d Catar-Buznay d iqrinen nnes di řxedmet ggin s cḍaret ɛlaḥsab řumur i tuɣa dd-issekk ujeǧid Dariyus.

Bnan imɣaren n Wudayen u nitni arnin mliḥ di řebni umi tuɣa ittnebba Ḥaggay d Zakariyya, mmis n Ɛiddu. Nitni bnan u kemmřen tt ɛlaḥsab řumur n Arebbi n Israil u ɛlaḥsab řumur n Kurac d Dariyus d Artaḥcasta, ajeǧid n Lfurs.
Uca ammu tᵉttwakemmeř Taddart deg wass wiss třata n uyur Adar, aqa-t d aseggʷas wiss setta n tgelda n ujeǧid Dariyus.
Ayt n Israil, ikehhanen d Ilawiyyen d ayt n lmenfa i iqqimen, deccnen Taddart-a n Arebbi s řefraḥet.
I udeccen n Taddart n Arebbi iwyen nitni mya n ifunasen, mitayen n icarriyyen d arebɛa-mya n izmaren d taɣarṣt, u i taɣarṣt n ddenb tenɛac n imuyan i marra Israil ɛlaḥsab řqedd n tqebbař n Israil.
Nitni ssbedden ikehhanen s terbiɛin nsen u Ilawiyyen di terbiɛin nsen i tsexxart i Arebbi nni iǧan di Urcalim, ɛlaḥsab tawṣeyyet n wedlis n Musa.
Deg wass wiss arbeɛṭac n uyur amezwaru sswejden ayt n lmenfa i Tɣarṣt n Useɛdu.
Minzi ikehhanen d Ilawiyyen ggin ad ssizdgen ixef nsen am yijj n weryaz. Tuɣa-ten marra d imezdagen u nitni ɣarṣen Taɣarṣt n Useɛdu i marra ayt n lmenfa u i aytmatsen ikehhanen u i yixef nsen.
Ayt n Israil, inni dd-iɛeqben zi lmenfa, ccin zzayes, uřa d kuř ijjen wenni tuɣa issarxun ixef nnes zi řexmej n řegnus n temmurt uca yusa-dd ɣarsen ḥima ad yarzu SIDI, AREBBI n Israil.

Sebɛa n wussan ɛeyyden nitni Řɛid n Weɣrum břa Antun, minzi SIDI tuɣa issefraḥ i-ten uca issmeyyeř uř n ujeǧid n Accur ɣarsen maḥend ad issejhed ifassen nsen ɣar řxedmet n Taddart n AREBBI, AREBBI n Israil.
